svg.title: The parts of Medicare, and what each one pays for
svg.desc: Part A covers hospital care. Part B covers doctors and outpatient care. Part D covers prescription drugs. Part C, Medicare Advantage, is a private plan that bundles them together.

text.style: font:700 30px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: The parts of Medicare, and what each one pays for

text.style: font:400 18px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#4a5568

svg.text: Original Medicare is Part A and Part B. Part D is added for drugs. Part C is a different way to get it all.

text.style: font:700 20px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#ffffff

svg.text: Prescription drugs you pick up at

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: a pharmacy. Sold by private plans.

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: Each plan covers its own list of

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d
font:700 20px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d
font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: A private plan that replaces Original Medicare. It must cover everything Parts A and B cover,

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: usually includes Part D, and often adds extras. In exchange you use the plan's network of

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#14213d

svg.text: doctors and follow its approval rules.

text.style: font:400 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#4a5568

svg.text: Medicare does not pay for long-term custodial care, and Original Medicare has no yearly limit on what you pay.

text.style: font:400 14px Georgia,'Noto Serif','WenQuanYi Zen Hei','Droid Sans Fallback',serif;fill:#7a8ba3
